subject.title: chore(deps): bump github.com/steipete/commander from 0.2.2 to 0.2.3 in /apps/swabble in the swift-deps group across 1 directory

question: Should this Dependabot bump be held for a coordinated SwiftPM graph update, or closed until upstream AXorcist and Peekaboo constraints are compatible with Commander 0.2.3?
rationale: The PR is mechanically small, but the safe outcome depends on upstream dependency-release timing or a maintainer choice to close the bot bump rather than an in-repo one-line repair.

options.title: Hold for compatible upstream graph
options.body: Wait until AXorcist and Peekaboo publish constraints that allow Commander 0.2.3, then refresh all affected SwiftPM manifests and lockfiles together.

options.title: Close this bot bump
options.body: Close this PR now and let Dependabot or a maintainer reopen the Commander update when the dependency graph can resolve.

options.title: Coordinate a manual release refresh
options.body: If upstream releases can be cut now, update AXorcist, Peekaboo, Swabble, and the macOS lockfile in one reviewed PR.

recommendation.title: Hold for compatible upstream graph
recommendation.body: Wait until AXorcist and Peekaboo publish constraints that allow Commander 0.2.3, then refresh all affected SwiftPM manifests and lockfiles together.

likelyOwner.reason: The blocking version constraints are in the steipete-owned Commander, AXorcist, and Peekaboo release chain.
